say:2:1520513001:1.text: Ugh, I've talked more today than I have the whole week.
say:2:1520513001:1.source_cn: 唉，一周说的话都没有今天一天多。
say:2:1520513001:1.male: Ugh, I've talked more today than I have the whole week.

say:4:1520513003:0.text: Nah. It takes a lot of energy to stay angry, and I'm too lazy for that.
say:4:1520513003:0.source_cn: 不，生气太费力气，我懒得生气。

say:6:1520513004:1.text: Don't worry about me. I won't waste my time dwelling on that boy and their absurd political system.
say:6:1520513004:1.source_cn: 不用劝我，对那个小孩和呼临的政治体系产生任何多余情感都...
say:6:1520513004:1.male: Don't worry about me. I won't waste my time dwelling on that boy and their absurd political system.
say:6:1520513004:1.female: Don't worry about me. I won't waste my time dwelling on that boy and their absurd political system.

say:7:1520513005:1.text: I shouldn't even worry about them getting hit by a plague.
say:7:1520513005:1.source_cn: 是我多虑了，他们根本不需要担心瘟疫带来的灾难。
say:7:1520513005:1.male: I shouldn't even worry about them getting hit by a plague.
say:7:1520513005:1.female: I shouldn't even worry about them getting hit by a plague.

say:8:1520513006:1.text: That boy alone can bring the city to its downfall. The plague won't even come into play.
say:8:1520513006:1.source_cn: 用不着疾病和细菌，他自己就能带着他的子民们走向灭亡。
say:8:1520513006:1.male: That boy alone can bring the city to its downfall. The plague won't even come into play.
say:8:1520513006:1.female: That boy alone can bring the city to its downfall. The plague won't even come into play.

say:9:1520513007:0.text: So, we can't get any help from the Halians.

say:9:1520513007:0.female: So, we can't get any help from the Halians.

say:10:1520513008:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's <style="highlight">visit Kordan at the Great Treehouse</style>.

say:11:1520513009:1.text: I hope I'll be talking to someone more sensible this time.
say:11:1520513009:1.source_cn: 希望你们雅库伯尔的首领别像呼临的领主大人一样“可靠”。

narration:12:1520513010:0.text: As time is of the essence, you reach Wrathwood Grove as quickly as you can...
narration:12:1520513010:0.source_cn: 时间紧迫，你们以最快速度抵达了树怒山谷……
